// Command probe decodes each book file named on the command line with lib's types-mode decoder
// and with app's data loader (the file's .data twin), printing one verdict line each
// (TestRefDependentRoundTrip, DECISIONS 350).
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"strings"

	"example.com/gen/app"
	"example.com/gen/lib"
)

func main() {
	for _, path := range os.Args[1:] {
		raw, err := os.ReadFile(path)
		if err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		b, err := lib.DecodeBook(raw)
		fmt.Println("go-types " + verdict(b, err))
		b, err = app.LoadBook(path + ".data")
		fmt.Println("go-data " + verdict(b, err))
	}
}

func verdict(b *lib.Book, err error) string {
	switch {
	case err != nil && strings.Contains(err.Error(), "no branch for this value"):
		return "error no branch"
	case err != nil:
		return "error other"
	}
	var entries []string
	for e := range b.Entries().All() {
		var more []string
		for p := range e.More().All() {
			more = append(more, show(p))
		}
		entries = append(entries, strings.Join([]string{
			"kind=" + string(e.KindID()), "payload=" + show(e.Payload()), "more=[" + strings.Join(more, ",") + "]",
			"ev=" + e.EvID().Wire(), "byEv=" + show(e.ByEv()),
			"num=" + strconv.FormatInt(e.NumID(), 10), "byNum=" + show(e.ByNum()),
			"flag=" + string(e.FlagID()), "byFlag=" + showFlag(e.ByFlag()),
			"alias=" + string(e.AliasID()), "byAlias=" + show(e.ByAlias()),
		}, " "))
	}
	return "ok " + strings.Join(entries, "; ")
}

func show(p *lib.Payload) string {
	if p == nil {
		return "none"
	}
	if n, ok := p.AsNum(); ok {
		return "num:" + strconv.FormatInt(n, 10)
	}
	if s, ok := p.AsText(); ok {
		return "text:" + s
	}
	return "?"
}

func showFlag(p *lib.ByFlag) string {
	if p == nil {
		return "none"
	}
	if n, ok := p.AsTrue(); ok {
		return "true:" + strconv.FormatInt(n, 10)
	}
	if s, ok := p.AsFalse(); ok {
		return "false:" + s
	}
	return "?"
}
